notes: Lead: Celestia Inbound Solutions — mid-stage e-commerce platform offering merchant messaging and automated order support.
Primary contact: Maya Lopez, CTO (quoted: 'We want a simple hosted API we can roll out to merchants quickly but legal needs SOC2 + DPA before pushing anything live').
Current status: experimenting with self-serve keys in sandbox. Interested in hosted_api only for now (no private deployment).

Security asks: SOC2 Type II report or attestation, full list of sub-processors, standard DPA with data processing addenda, confirmation of access controls and audit logs, KMS options for key separation, and token retention policy for KV/prefix caching.

Workload estimate from product: ~30M input+output tokens/month initially (~1M tokens/day peak), mostly chat-based support flows with occasional embeddings for ticket similarity. Latency target: 200-400ms per token for chat generation at 1-2 concurrent streams per merchant. Throughput not extreme but cost-sensitive — wants guidance on batching/quantization to reduce unit-costs.

Model preferences: prefer open model variants for cost predictability but will consider higher-capacity hosted models if redwood provides clear fallback & cost routing. Wants automatic fallback to a cheaper variant if rate-limited.

Integration notes: they use Okta SSO (asked about SAML/SCIM for console), expect audit logging for token usage per merchant, and need a DPA clause for subcontractors/sub-processors. Also flagged EU customers — asked whether hosted API supports EU data residency (they prefer public cloud eu region options).
Quote from CTO in security questionnaire: 'We need to know who you share data with and how long you keep customer prompts — legal will block anything without the DPA and subprocessor list.'
AE notes: keep POC scope small — 2 merchants, 2-week POC, rollup metric = reduction in average handle time by 20% and acceptable cost per conversation.
requirements_summary: POC: hosted_api, public cloud (prefer us + eu regions), SOC2 attestation + DPA required before production. Workload: chat support + periodic embeddings; ~1M tokens/day peak; latency SLO ~200-400ms/token; cost sensitivity high. Needs subprocessor list, KMS options, audit logs, and SAML for console. POC success criteria: functional integration + legal signoff on DPA.
